Only include profile domains and persona style when the user explicitly requests them. Keep profile summaries minimal by default.

content.user_title: Score X Topics With Weighted Filters
content.value_statement: Content teams often collect more topic ideas than they can publish. This skill scores each idea and highlights the strongest options for X posts.
actual_capabilities: Scores each topic on trend strength, controversy, value, and account relevance.
Uses a 10-point rubric with a default publish threshold of 7 points.
Sorts topics into selected, pending, and rejected groups.
Suggests content format and creative angle for high-scoring topics.
Supports material from x-collect output, manual topic lists, or raw text.
limitations: Trend and controversy scores depend on the evidence supplied by the user.
It does not fetch live X metrics or verify URLs by itself.
Profile-based relevance requires profile details or an accessible profile file.
Scores are editorial guidance, not a guarantee of engagement.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Daily Topics
use_cases.description: Rank a batch of collected ideas and choose which X posts deserve immediate writing time.

use_cases.title: Review Campaign Ideas
use_cases.description: Compare social content angles with a shared rubric before assigning posts to writers.

use_cases.title: Filter Research Notes
use_cases.description: Turn raw research notes into selected, pending, and rejected topic groups for planning.

prompt_templates.title: Score a Short Topic List
prompt_templates.prompt: Use x-filter to score these X topic ideas. Show selected, pending, and rejected groups: [paste topics].

prompt_templates.title: Filter Collected Materials
prompt_templates.prompt: Use x-filter on this x-collect report. Prioritize topics scoring 7 or higher and explain each score briefly: [paste report].

prompt_templates.title: Apply My Positioning
prompt_templates.prompt: Use x-filter with this profile summary: [profile]. Score these materials and include relevance reasoning for each topic: [materials].

prompt_templates.title: Tune the Scoring Rubric
prompt_templates.prompt: Use x-filter with weights trending 3, controversy 2, value 4, relevance 1, threshold 8. Rank these topics and recommend formats: [materials].

output_examples.input: Three AI product launch topics with mixed relevance to the account.
output_examples.output: A ranked screening report with two selected topics, one pending topic, score reasons, and a recommended first post.

output_examples.input: A raw list of startup, AI, and personal growth ideas.
output_examples.output: A grouped topic shortlist that separates strong X post candidates from low-priority ideas.

output_examples.input: Collected social media research plus a creator positioning summary.
output_examples.output: Profile-aware topic scores with recommended post formats and concise creative angles.

best_practices: Provide source context for each topic so trend and value scores are grounded.
Share profile details explicitly when relevance scoring matters.
Review pending topics manually before rejecting time-sensitive ideas.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the score as proof that a post will perform well.
Do not ask the skill to score topics without enough context.
Do not include private profile details unless they are needed for relevance scoring.

faq.question: What does this skill score?
faq.answer: It scores X topic ideas on trend strength, controversy, value, and account relevance.

faq.question: What score is selected for creation?
faq.answer: The default threshold is 7 out of 10 points.

faq.question: Can I change the scoring weights?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill supports custom weights for trend, controversy, value, relevance, and threshold.

faq.question: Does it collect live data from X?
faq.answer: No. It evaluates materials supplied by the user or another collection workflow.

faq.question: Does it need my profile?
faq.answer: Profile details improve relevance scoring, but users should provide or approve that information explicitly.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
